title: Define goal domain events and pure reducer
description: Create discriminated GoalState and GoalEvent types plus pure reducer transitions for lifecycle, usage, progress, continuation, and evaluation. Acceptance: no Pi imports; reducer tests cover valid transitions and rejected stale transitions.

logs.msg: Implemented extensions/pi-goal/domain.ts with pure GoalEvent reducer, run leases, progress policy, independent usage/time limits, evaluation claims, and stale transition rejection. Tests: domain.test.ts.
